sentences.text: Core=true: The documents are an unrelated mix of a Hindi application receipt and a TBO OpsDesk / VoyageHack deck.

The receipt shows application reference SS/2026/KDG/09001, the office as अनु विभागीय अधिकारी (राजस्व), कोंडागांव, a caste certificate number ••••4512 (अभिलेखागार से सत्यापित), and a note that the अधिकारी 22 दिन में निर्णय लेंगे.
The TBO deck describes OpsDesk as a queueing and routing system where email, call, or chat joins one case, by region, load, and shift, with deadlines and money used to set order and escalation.
It also says booking TBOH-90217 is from synthetic demo data, offline cancellations within 24 h are part of the case, and a ₹1,12,000 penalty applies after 15:00.
